title: First-person handheld motion
summary: Handheld items stay visible near walls and sway naturally as you look and move.
notes: Render first-person items and arms on a separate camera layer to prevent wall clipping.
Add slower aim sway and velocity-driven movement bob to all handheld items and generated guns.
Layer whole-viewmodel momentum drift, jump lag and springy landing recovery over handheld bob and look sway.
